items.title: Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2022
items.q: I think Norman Bates was the bass player.

ctx.x: You know and then also he had to deal with prejudice everywhere, like the tours of the south where they would say, “You can’t go on stage with that guy,” and you know all that kind of stuff. Dave canceled huge amounts of concerts in the south, I forget how many there were, like 23 concerts or something where when they found out that — because the quartet before they got Gene it was an all-white group.
I think Norman Bates was the bass player.

You know and on Jazz Goes to College and all that. So the image is oh great, it’s a white jazz group, that’ll fly. So once there was the addition of Gene then you know they weren’t so sure they wanted that on stage.
